name: SNMP Manager
description: A bounded SNMPv1/SNMPv2c manager for ESP8266 and ESP32 with typed queries, GETNEXT/GETBULK walks, tables, SET, and notification reception. Use 2.x for new projects. Existing 1.x sketches should select the latest 1.x release; 1.x remains maintained. Migrating to 2.x requires code changes.
